items.summary: Financial recommendation: preserve containment and admit no new spend or production work. Revenue support is insufficient for ROI, contribution margin, or forecast claims: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21 and reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under an unattributed provider row. AI usage is $2.2785467 for 16 calls across 4 instrumented sites on 2026-10-01, but coverage is only 4 of 38 expected sites. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Keep the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA work capacity-gated and measure only clicks, orders, commission, and directly attributable costs after release. Do not claim margin, ROI, payback, or causal lift.

Attribution disposition: site-level revenue is not supportable for the current Amazon window. Named tracking rows are mapped, but all $4.92 commission is in an aggregate row that cannot be assigned to a site without inventing attribution. Minimum measurement for a supported site claim: provider tracking ID mapped to the site/content identifier, provider-reported clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, reporting period, and reconciliation timestamp.

Contribution-margin disposition: contribution margin is not calculable. The brief provides aggregate commission and partial AI cost, but no complete site-period cost ledger for hosting, infrastructure, domains, AI, labor, marketing, or other directly attributable costs. Minimum measurement: dated site-level revenue plus directly attributable cash costs by site and period, including infrastructure allocation basis and AI usage costs; then calculate contribution margin as attributable revenue less those directly attributable costs.

Cost-to-learn disposition: a defensible cost per learned revenue or conversion outcome is not calculable because no site-attributed commission is reported, experiments have no completed measured outcomes, and causal lift is unknown. The current AI usage cost can only be described as $2.2785467 for 16 calls, or approximately $0.1424 per call, not as ROI or cost-to-learn. Minimum measurement: approved hypothesis, exposure count, outcome definition, attributable revenue or conversion result, and all directly attributable learning costs over a fixed window.

Budget exposure disposition: no monthly revenue target, fixed-cost budget, marketing budget, revenue floor, or attribution materiality threshold is populated. Infrastructure spend is absent from the snapshot, and AI-cost coverage is partial at 4 of 38 expected sites. Treat budget exposure as unknown and authorize no incremental spend, billing change, banking access, contract, or credential action. Minimum measurement: owner-approved budget ceilings, current committed recurring costs, variable usage costs, renewal dates, and site-level allocation rules.
